pricing._note: Showroom pricing — set by CST for demo purposes, following the same tier framework every tenant uses. Class-of-trade only applies to DIRECT sales; distributor sales = base FOB + delivery/minimum/fees.

tiers.label: Wholesale / Distributor (price list)
tiers._note: Base FOB price — no class-of-trade markup; the distributor adds their own margin downstream.

tiers.label: Direct to Retail
tiers._note: Alpine Rind selling direct to a retailer — absorbs distributor margin, holds market value at +15%.

tiers.label: Direct to Consumer
tiers._note: DTC e-comm — +35% over the e-comm baseline, market value protected.

freight._note: Freight/handling are separate line items on the proforma — never folded into $/lb, added at proforma time. Pickup (EXW Waitsfield) = no freight lines.

delivered._note: Trucking = $0.34/lb, floored at a $200 New England regional minimum; rep overrides for distance. Processing fee = $95 on delivered orders under the 500 lb threshold.

fees.label: Trucking
fees._note: Auto-suggested from freight rules above; rep overrides with the real distance rate.
